#include "gesummv.h"

#define N 30

void kernel_gesummv(
    double alpha,
    double beta,
    double A[30][30],
    double B[30][30],
    double tmp[30],
    double x[30],
    double y[30]) {
    int i, j;

    for (i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        tmp[i] = 0.0;
        y[i] = 0.0;

        for (j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            tmp[i] += A[i][j] * x[j];
            y[i] += B[i][j] * x[j];
        }

        y[i] = alpha * tmp[i] + beta * y[i];
    }
}
